      protected void reshape()
      Description copied from class: PolygonItem
      Reshape the polygon based on the modification. Not much we can do to a polygon except move the selected point. Keep in mind that if control or shift was pressed, the polygon will scale rather than coming here.

      public Point[] getSelectionPoints(IContainer container)
      Description copied from class: AItem
